Options by name: a skipped optional argument gets its empty value

Models pass optional arguments by name, not position: on the first
SWE-bench dev tasks with the new file tools, "argument context needs glob
too" and "count needs start too" were 10 of 17 failed file tool calls.
A skipped optional argument before a later one that is given now gets its
type's empty value ("", 0, #f, ()), which the handlers treat as not given:
fs-read's start 0 is line 1 and index-grep's glob "" is every file. index-
grep caps context above 5 instead of refusing it (models asked for 6, 8
and 10). ADR 29 amended.
